sloka: यस्येयं प्रथमं दत्ता समृद्धा मनुना मही ।तमिक्ष्वाकुमयोध्यायां राजानं विद्धि पूर्वकम् ॥ २.११०.७॥
transliteration: yasyeyaṁ prathamaṁ dattā samṛddhā manunā mahī ।tamikṣvākumayodhyāyāṁ rājānaṁ viddhi pūrvakam ॥ 2.110.7॥

translations.english: Manu had orginally bestowed the most prosperous earth on Ikshvaku and you know Ikshvaku was the first king of Ayodhya.
